card.name: Linking words in place descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking or partway-through words right before a place name or geographic term, in encyclopedia-style text about cities, regions, coastlines and travel routes.

modes.label: Words before a country or region
modes.description: The word "the" or a similar linker sits just before a country, state or government name.
modes.example: Richmond is the capital of<< the>> Commonwealth of Virginia, in the United States.

modes.label: Inside place-related words
modes.description: Partway through words like seashore or homonymous in descriptions of places.
modes.example: on the western<< se>>ashore of Gotland Island in Sweden

modes.label: Flight route listings
modes.description: Header or bracket words in travel itineraries listing cities and airport codes.
